annotations.title: Start an order (online or AI phone)

description: Starts a food order at a Deenwise partner restaurant for the person you are helping: matches the dishes they want to the live menu and returns a link to the restaurant's own order page with the basket filled in. The person checks it, signs in and pays there, and the order goes straight to the restaurant's till (no commission app). If the restaurant has a Deenwise AI phone receptionist, its number is given too, so the person can order by phone. Nothing is ordered or paid by this tool.

dish.description: Dish name as on the menu

size.description: Size name if the dish has sizes
